These are recorded here from the fan wikis, but nobody has yet opened the
    VGO Emulator client and confirmed them. They may be exactly right, they may
    carry figures the game never used, or they may not be in the emulator at
    all — there is no way to tell from the sources alone.
    
      Of this class's 196 abilities,
      152 have had their tooltip read in game, and 27 were looked for and not
      found .
    
    Where a tooltip has been read it overrides the wikis, and around four in
    five disagreed with them — so treat the figures below with care.

rows.detail_main_html:
Power of the Grave I

Necromancer · Level 1 · Alteration

Effect

Grants your defensive target's party unnatural vigor and intellect, increasing both constitution and intelligence by 9

Ranks

RankLevelCostEffect
I 1 19 +9 to constitution and intelligence
II 10 46 +19 to constitution and intelligence
III 20 73 +31 to constitution and intelligence
IV 30 101 +44 to constitution and intelligence
V 40 129 +56 to constitution and intelligence
VI 50 143 +69 to constitution and intelligence

Not in the emulator. This ability is recorded here but does not appear in the VGO Emulator build. It is kept because this archive records the game as it shipped — see everything else missing from it. Its figures are unverified.

As it was earlier

Grants your defensive target's party unnatural vigor and intellect, increasing both constitution and intelligence by 9.

Ten Ton Hammer class guides, 2007-2008 · every ability that changed

Level in 2008
1

vgnecro.com, 2008 · every ability that changed

Notes

Not present in the VGO Emulator build as of August 2026 — a player at the level cap went through the whole Necromancer spellbook and does not have it. Kept because this archive records the game as it shipped, not the emulator; the figures are the wiki's and unverified.

Group

The target was recorded as “Offensive”, which its own effect text contradicts — it grants your defensive target's party unnatural vigor. The Telon Project page it came from prints the real target under Notes, where it reads “Group”, the same fault that put a refresh value in Rest of the Dead II's cast time. Corrected to Group; nobody has read this off the client.

Ritual Animatus I

Necromancer · Level 14 · Conjuration

Effect

A dark ritual that reanimates a targeted corpse, forcing it to fight for you for a brief time. Only works on targets with 3 dots and below.

Ranks

RankLevelCostEffect
I 14 112 Raises a fallen opponent
II 42 338 Raises a fallen opponent

As it was earlier

What guides written while Vanguard was running recorded for this ability. Kept beside the current figures rather than replacing them — the game was rebalanced across its life, so both are right for their own year.

Level in 2007-2008
14
Cast then
2
Refresh then
0

Level in 2008
20

vgnecro.com, 2008 · every ability that changed

Notes

Self

Granted by The Art Of Death, a level 20 quest from Master Vallexx deep inside Kalendra's Coven in north-east Qalia. He feigns death in front of you at the end; the quest only completes if you wait for him to get up and speak to him again. Walkthrough from a Ten Ton Hammer guide by Polkadots, “The Art of Death Quest for Necromancer Feign Death Spell”, updated 2 January 2009 and captured by the Wayback Machine in 2012.

Previously recorded as: “Enables you to fake your own death”

This was wrongly set aside as missing from the VGO Emulator build. It is a learned ability, and a learned ability does not appear in the class spellbook until it has been learned — so a sweep of the spellbook cannot show that the build lacks it, only that this character has not got it yet. Rest of the Dead I settled the point: it was marked absent on that reasoning, and a player then finished The Art Of Death and read it off the client.

Read from the in-game tooltip in VGO Emulator, on completing The Art Of Death. Bracketed damage figures shown in game are the skill- and level-adjusted values for that character and are not recorded here.

Enables you to fake your own death.

Ten Ton Hammer class guides, 2007-2008 · every ability that changed

Level in 2008
20

vgnecro.com, 2008 · every ability that changed

Notes

Self

Granted by The Art Of Death, a level 20 quest from Master Vallexx deep inside Kalendra's Coven in north-east Qalia. He feigns death in front of you at the end; the quest only completes if you wait for him to get up and speak to him again. Walkthrough from a Ten Ton Hammer guide by Polkadots, “The Art of Death Quest for Necromancer Feign Death Spell”, updated 2 January 2009 and captured by the Wayback Machine in 2012.

Previously recorded as: “Enables you to fake your own death”

This was wrongly set aside as missing from the VGO Emulator build. It is a learned ability, and a learned ability does not appear in the class spellbook until it has been learned — so a sweep of the spellbook cannot show that the build lacks it, only that this character has not got it yet. Rest of the Dead I settled the point: it was marked absent on that reasoning, and a player then finished The Art Of Death and read it off the client.

Read from the in-game tooltip in VGO Emulator, on completing The Art Of Death. Bracketed damage figures shown in game are the skill- and level-adjusted values for that character and are not recorded here.
